summary: State setter on a _DWORD array (this): writes two adjacent state fields this[1271] (offset 0x13DC) and this[1272] (offset 0x13E0) based on the mode argument a2. Mode 0 clears both to 0, mode 1 sets both to 1, mode 2 sets this[1272] to 2 and this[1271] to 1. Returns a2. Only caller is VidMan_Enter.

operations.description: result = a2: the mode argument is preserved and becomes the return value.
Branch on a2: 0 clears both state fields, 1 sets both to 1, 2 sets this[1272]=2 / this[1271]=1; other values leave the fields untouched.
Returns result, i.e. the original a2 mode value.

unresolved: Exact meaning of the two state fields at 0x13DC and 0x13E0 is unknown; they are only ever written 0/1 and 0/1/2 respectively.
Field 0x13E0 accepts 2 while field 0x13DC never exceeds 1; the asymmetry is unexplained.
The owning object type is unknown; the caller VidMan_Enter suggests a graphics/video configuration object.
